title: S7 wordmark-band — one phrase at display scale on a full-bleed colour field
idea: One short phrase set to the full width of a flat colour field, with two small facts under it. The band says one thing at the loudest volume the page has.
why_new: type-manifesto gives the hero an imageless display register; below the hero there is no equivalent, so a page's only loud moment is its first band.
built_from: one full-aligned group on a contrast surface and one heading carrying the existing has-fit-text device — which today only footer-composition.md teaches. This is the cheapest way to put that device to work outside the footer.
risk: fit-text needs a genuinely full-width heading and renders only where the running WordPress version ships it, so it needs a fallback size. Cap at one per site, or every page becomes a shouting match.
